text: Thus says the LORD, For the three impious deeds of Moab, even for four, I shall not turn away from it. Because they incinerated the bones of the king of Edom into powder.
And I will send fire upon Moab, and it shall devour the foundations of the cities. And [[2]shall die [3]in [4]powerlessness [1]Moab] with a sound and with a cry of a trumpet.

Thus says the LORD, For the three impious deeds of Israel, even for the four, I will not turn away from. Because they rendered silver for the just, and the needy for sandals;
